personal.name: Sameer Masih

personal.bio: I build modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications with React and modern frontend technologies.

about.intro: Hi, I'm Sameer Masih — a frontend developer and BSIT student with a passion for building clean, modern web experiences.
paragraphs: I enjoy turning ideas into real, working applications. My journey into web development started with HTML and CSS, and has grown into building full React applications with modern tooling like Vite, Tailwind CSS, and state management libraries.
I've built over 10 real-world projects ranging from movie discovery apps and AI chatbots to weather apps and note-taking tools — each one helping me sharpen my skills and learn something new.

I'm continuously expanding my knowledge across the modern JavaScript ecosystem, including React, Firebase, TanStack React Query, Redux Toolkit, and beyond. I love building things that are not just functional, but genuinely enjoyable to use.
about.currentFocus: Currently focused on strengthening my React skills, exploring backend technologies, and building projects that solve real problems.
